messages:
samir: quick heads-up — courier left a tall potted fern and a small dog carrier labeled "guide dog - DO NOT OPEN" for our 11am visitor (Anna K.). Front desk said the visitor-sticker roll snapped when printing. Need someone to grab the dolly and a travel water bowl + make a paper badge. :herb: :dog2:
frontdesk: delivery note — items on the left bench by the planters. visitor-rolls = 0, we have blank badge cards in supply closet. kiosk is offline so handwritten will do. we will not open the carrier.
zoe: I can grab the dolly and a collapsible water bowl, leaving in reception in ~4 mins. which locker for the fern if we need to store?
samir: plant fits on Plant Rack-3; if locking needed use Locker-9. code:
```
7310
```
also please make a blue paper badge and write "Anna K." then staple to lanyard.
eli: I'll be the escort for Anna. @zoe thanks — please leave dolly by reception and bowl on counter. if it's a guide dog we shouldn't ask to crate it; prepare a quiet seat in the lounge. frontdesk, flag security if courier comes back asking for the carrier.
courier-bot: delivery update: TRK-GDN-334 delivered at 10:22. sender: "GreenSteps". photo attached to record.
frontdesk: dolly placed at reception, paper badge written and taped to lanyard. plant moved to Plant Rack-3 with sticky: "Anna K. - do not water until 12:00". water bowl by carrier. Quiet Room 2 reserved for 11am. escort scheduled. kiosk ticket opened for sticker rolls.
samir: thank you everyone. small note for folks: if guest has a guide dog don't ask them to crate or remove it — treat like any other visitor. I'll add a one-liner to the frontdesk checklist. (reaction: :heart:)
file_notes: watercooler: visitor with guide dog + tall plant delivery, broken sticker roll, dolly and water bowl arranged, locker code and seating/escort arranged
